data.body: Status update (2026-05-17): initial implementation shipped via PR #212 (merge commit 464ecfebd8). CodeRabbit caught a design defect in §B during the merge review: the prompt instructed reviewers to issue a content 'grep' request for the basename, but 'grep' searches file contents, not filenames — so a basename grep would match every workflow / script / doc that REFERENCES the basename, not the file itself, and would suppress legitimate 'file does not exist' findings (false negatives). The within-contract fix is a multi-path 'read_files' candidate cascade: reviewer constructs the basename under common subdirectory prefixes and the dispatcher reads every candidate in one call. Existence is proven only when ALL candidates return missing. Follow-up shipped as PR #213 (branch fix/code-reviewer-b-design-defect). Will close this ticket when PR #213 merges.
